Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an arbitrary “earlier-year tie-breaker” to resolve date ranges (405–406 or 406–407) and concluded 405 CE, disregarding the evidence that the Rhine crossing occurred at the end of 406 (often specified as December 31, 406). This misapplied rule contradicted both the sources and the question’s “at the end of which year” phrasing, leading to the incorrect answer.
